final.summary: The ETP was stopped for planned maintenance from 14:00 to 17:05 on 13 Oct 2026. During the stop, equalization tank level rose from 0.43 to 0.81 fraction, ETP inflow and outfall flow were flat at zero, and outfall pH stayed near 7.3, indicating wastewater was held and no untreated discharge occurred. After restart, ETP power matches inflow load and outfall pH remains neutral, showing treatment resumed. Power data are missing from 14:00 to 23:05, so aeration during the early post-maintenance period cannot be verified from the feed.

steps.why: Check tank balance: inflow should equal storage increase if ETP inflow zero and outfall zero.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.
